name: Alsace grand cru Altenberg de Bergbieten

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Riesling, Gewürztraminer and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
land: Faces the midday sun. In a climate this cool, that extra warmth is often what gets grapes fully ripe.

blurb.text: A white wine grand cru from the Altenberg vineyard at Bergbieten, in Bas-Rhin, Alsace. It is one of fifty-one Alsace grands crus, each with its own appellation but sharing the Alsace Grand Cru rules. Riesling, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Gris and Muscat are allowed.
